pages.text: $(bold)How to obtain$():$(li)Dark Metal Ingots come from Goety (the $(l:https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/goety)Goety$() mod's $(bold)goety:dark_ingot$())$(li)Throw Dark Metal Ingots into the Smeltery to melt them into $(bold)Molten Dark Metal$() (90 mB per ingot, temperature 1000)$(li)At the Casting Table, pour $(bold)90 mB$() of Molten Dark Metal (1 ingot) to cast Dark Metal parts$(br2)Tier: $(bold)T2$() (secondary material, iron mining level; stats slightly above iron).

$(bold)Innate traits$():$(li)$(bold)Malleable$() (native to Tinkers): a ductile metal that reduces tool durability loss$(li)$(bold)Soul Mending I$(): every 20 ticks, spend 5 soul energy to restore 1 durability (works while held in your main hand or off hand) - Dark Metal gear mainly heals itself this way$(li)$(bold)Spell Breaker$() (tool part): attacks inflict Weakness I (2 seconds) on the target; slaying a creature with magic resistance grants a 45% chance to drop 1 extra Emerald$(li)$(bold)Magic Resist$() (armor part): when taking magic damage, convert 5% + 1.5 points of it into physical damage$(br2)Stats: head 300 durability / iron mining / 7.0 speed / 2.5 attack; chestplate armor +6.
